description: Search 800,000+ artworks at the Rijksmuseum (Dutch national museum) by title, description, creation date, or object number. Returns Linked Open Data object IDs — use rijks.details for full metadata. Covers Rembrandt, Vermeer, Van Gogh, and centuries of Dutch art. CC-BY license (Rijksmuseum)

creation_date.description: Filter by creation year or date (e.g. "1642", "1665")

object_number.description: Rijksmuseum object number (e.g. "SK-C-5" for Night Watch)

name: rijks.art.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Rijksmuseum Collection
